info.title: Lunate - a coding agent for the terminal.
info.description: A native C# coding agent for the terminal.

options.name: --continue
options.description:
continue the newest session recorded for this
working directory

options.name: --resume
options.description:
choose a session from the interactive picker
(print mode cannot draw it; use --session or

options.name: --session
options.description: load one session by id or file path

options.name: --no-session
options.description: run without writing a session file

options.name: --model
options.description: use this model for the run (wins over settings)

options.name: --thinking
options.description: off, low, medium or high for the run

options.name: --tools
options.description: expose only these comma-separated tool names

options.name: --extra-tools
options.description: enable optional search tools (grep, find, ls)

options.name: --no-tools
options.description: expose no tools for the run

options.name: --system-prompt
options.description:
replace the composed system prompt wholesale,
including the tool-call conventions: the caller
owns them

options.name: --append-system-prompt
options.description: append a section after the composed system prompt
